acceptance: morize-core exports ErrorCategory from one new error module with all 13 baseline public error categories documented by docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md and no concrete error payload behavior.

ErrorCategory is marked non_exhaustive so the policy wording at least does not become an accidental closed future taxonomy; the current implementation adds no category beyond the 13 documented baseline categories.
Every baseline variant is fieldless, including NotFound, so this Grain does not introduce protected-existence detail or other diagnostic payload.
ErrorCategory supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests exercise all 13 variants and confirm distinct value semantics without defining an ordering contract.

The implementation defines no Display, FromStr, std::error::Error implementation, concrete error payload/message/source, retryability flag, transport/status/exit-code mapping, serde integration, numeric repr/discriminants, or wire/persistence format.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and includes focused tests for all baseline error categories and required value semantics.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain admits no runtime, build, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for baseline-category fidelity, non-exhaustive extensibility, fieldless/no-leak shape, absence of invented payload/transport/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite for SG-000011 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
The implementation changes no path outside crates/morize-core/src/error.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free non-exhaustive in-memory error-category enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No concrete error payload, message text, source chaining, retryability flag, transport/status/exit-code mapping, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, baseline-category fidelity, non-exhaustive extensibility, absence of transport/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the baseline error-category implementation commits; no persisted format, migration, transport contract, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: A single standard-library-only non-exhaustive enum inside existing morize-core is the narrowest implementation of the already-documented baseline public error taxonomy. It preserves future extension while deferring payloads, messages, retry policy, transport mappings, serialization, and persistence.

requirements: The NotFound baseline category must remain fieldless in this Grain and must not introduce protected-existence disclosure detail or payload.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive ErrorCategory enum covering every baseline public error category already fixed by docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md, without defining error payloads, messages, transport mappings, retry policy, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependencies.
rationale: P1 requires a stable public error taxonomy, and docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md already fixes the baseline categories while explicitly saying public APIs should distinguish at least those categories. This Grain adds only the typed in-memory category vocabulary and preserves future extension without deciding concrete error payload or wire behavior.

risk.recovery: Revert the baseline error-category implementation commits; no persisted format, migration, transport contract, or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public non-exhaustive ErrorCategory with the 13 baseline categories fixed by docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md: InvalidInput, UnsupportedVersion, AuthenticationFailure, AuthorizationDenial, ConflictOrStalePrecondition, ReviewRequired, Quarantine, NotFound, ResourceOrBudgetExceeded, TransientProviderFailure, PermanentConnectorFailure, UnresolvedOrUnknownWriteOutcome, and InternalCorruptionOrRecoveryRequired.

Keep every baseline category fieldless and derive only Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash so the vocabulary is typed without defining payload, ordering, text, retry, transport, or persistence semantics.
Document that NotFound is the category used where protected existence must not be leaked, without defining a diagnostic payload or disclosure mechanism in this Grain.
Add standard-library-only focused tests that exercise all 13 baseline variants, prove they are distinct hashable values, and prove Copy behavior without textual or numeric encoding.
scope_out: Concrete error structs/enums carrying payloads, diagnostic message text, source/error chaining, backtraces, retryability flags, error codes, HTTP/IPC/MCP status mappings, CLI exit codes, or authorization disclosure behavior.
Display/FromStr, serde or other serialization integration, numeric repr/discriminants, persisted or wire encoding, configuration formats, migrations, storage, retrieval, or domain-record integration.
Any third-party runtime, build, or test dependency.
